prompt: Style & Mood: Natural-history agricultural realism at soft sunrise, restrained deep greens, dark brown soil, golden straw, blossom white and true strawberry red. Low eye-level 50mm macro perspective, shallow but believable depth of field, gentle morning mist, fixed light direction from left to right. Narrative Summary: One strawberry plant advances from newly established leaves through flowering, pollination, fruit formation, ripening and careful harvest in one continuous fifteen-second growth journey. Dynamic Description: The camera begins low beside the raised row and performs one extremely slow continuous dolly-in with no cuts. A small strawberry plant holds center-right while its leaves gradually unfold and gain volume, dew forming on matte serrated surfaces as a single irrigation droplet darkens the soil near the roots. White blossoms open from their real stems; one bumblebee enters from the left, lands briefly on the central blossom, transfers pollen and departs forward without returning. The central flower naturally closes and develops into a tiny green strawberry; the fruit enlarges in place, shifts from green through pale cream to an imperfect ripe red while the same leaves and stems remain spatially consistent. Near the end, one ungloved harvesting hand enters from the right, pinches the ripe fruit by its stem, lifts it cleanly, and lowers it into a plain recyclable corrugated-cardboard berry basket visible at the lower edge. The camera settles and holds on the basket and the still-living plant. Static Description: Authentic raised strawberry row near Zwingenberg on the Bergstraße, clean golden straw, crumbly dark soil, repeating field rows and a translucent protective tunnel softly out of focus. One botanically accurate strawberry plant, one bumblebee, one harvesting hand, one unbranded cardboard basket. No text, logos, labels or additional props. Keep the left thirty-five percent visually calm for website interface copy.

风格与氛围：柔和日出光下的自然农业写实影像，深绿叶片、深褐土壤、金色稻草、白色花朵与真实草莓红。低机位50毫米微距视角，浅景深自然可信，晨雾轻薄，光线始终由左向右。叙事概述：同一株草莓在十五秒连续镜头中经历扎根、展叶、开花、授粉、结果、成熟与人工采摘。动态描述：镜头贴近垄面，以极慢速度持续推进，全程不切镜。画面中右侧的一株草莓保持固定位置，叶片逐渐舒展并增加体量，锯齿状哑光叶面凝结露珠，一滴灌溉水落入根部附近并使土壤颜色变深。白色花朵从原有花茎自然绽放；一只熊蜂从左侧飞入，短暂停留在中央花朵完成授粉，随后向前飞离且不再返回。中央花朵自然收拢，在原位形成微小绿色果实；果实逐渐增大，由绿色转为浅白，再变成形状略不规则的成熟红色，所有叶片和茎秆保持空间连续。结尾，一只未戴手套的采摘手从右侧进入，捏住果柄摘下果实，将其放入画面下缘的无品牌可回收瓦楞纸果篮。镜头停止推进，短暂保持果篮与仍在生长的植株。静态描述：德国贝格施特拉瑟茨温根贝格附近的真实草莓垄，干净金色稻草、松散深色土壤、背景重复田垄与虚化半透明保护棚。同一株植物、一只熊蜂、一只手、一个无品牌纸篮。无文字、标识、标签及额外道具。画面左侧百分之三十五保持简洁，供网页界面文字使用。
